ssl_mode: MIFOS_VERIFY_SSL env flag (default true; set false for self-signed)
backend_validation_flow: Local Django credential check (client/password), then admin-only Fineract availability check with Basic Auth and tenant header/query on /authentication or /self/authentication; cp_session session is issued after the health check succeeds

authentication_model.notes: Client credentials are not Fineract users. Django validates them locally and uses the Fineract admin account for all upstream calls.

notes: Angular clientportal is a lazy-loaded feature module under src/app/clientportal.
Django backend acts as middleware between Angular and future Fineract/Mifos APIs.
All Angular -> Django HTTP calls must use withCredentials: true.
Django session cookie is named cp_session with SameSite=Lax and HttpOnly.
Django /auth/login accepts only fixed credentials client/password for Day 1.
Django /dashboard confirms session and returns a readiness message for further Fineract integration.
Future days will implement real MifosConnector behavior using mifos_client.MifosClient for data APIs.
Backend error responses use correlation_id and map 401 to invalid credentials and 503 to upstream_unavailable.
